question: Can the exact Grid6 posterior predictive teach a direct incomplete-input GraphPFN more efficiently than sampled-label CE, without changing architecture, training tasks or update budget?
train_bank: Reuse the immutable disjoint_factor_pilot train bank and per-seed schedule; no new training examples or extra updates. Initialize from the original per-seed initialization, never from a trained CE checkpoint.
teacher: Grid6 exact, not BP: marginalize all twelve binary node labels, four role states, six parameter candidates with historical prior masses and four independent feature orientations. Condition only on graph, observed feature cells, original mask, context labels and known family. Never condition on sampled query/helper labels or true task parameters. Teach only query rows. Offline teacher generation is additional training cost.
objective: Query-wise KL(exact Grid6 predictive || student predictive), equivalently soft-label cross entropy up to teacher entropy. Temperature1, no hard-label mixture, no auxiliary loss or test tuning. Teacher detached. Backpropagate through all original trainable computations including self role weights in FactorPFN.
controls: Reevaluate the original nine CE-trained Mask, PCFI and Factor checkpoints on the fresh test bank. Verify original initialization, schedule, optimizer and trainable parameter count against each new student's paired CE checkpoint. Retain fixed-mode factor BP, exact Grid6, Grid6-BP, feature-only, LP and class-prior controls. Do not retrain CE or select among test checkpoints.
test: Fresh96 graph seeds,32 per Independent/Exclusive/Coupled prior. Within each prior case schedule matched,matched,density_low,signal_high:48 matched,24 low density,24 high signal. Each graph has contexts1/2/4 x observed-count3/6 x disjoint/paired-overlap:1152 standard episodes. Same twelve-node binary typed SBM with two Gaussian features and fully observed edge/nonedge pairs. This is feature missing, not missing graph observations.
primary: Matched disjoint episodes, all target queries. Primary outcome is exact-Grid6 predictive KL of Mask distillation minus Mask CE, averaged over episode settings and three fixed training seeds within each of48 base graphs. Accuracy, sampled-label NLL and Brier are separate outcomes. Grid6 KL is a known-family reference, not true Bayes KL on density/signal OOD.
secondary: Factor distillation vs Factor CE; query itself without features; paired-overlap, density-low and signal-high partitions; prior-specific descriptive results. No secondary replaces a failed primary. No multiplicity correction or training-seed population inference is claimed.
interventions: Matched disjoint context2/observed6: remove all physical feature observations, shuffle observed feature values among observed nodes per column, or permute graph nodes within type while retaining X/mask/context. Recompute public structural inputs and PCFI as appropriate. No query truth enters interventions. These diagnose sensitivity, not independent validation or a selected hybrid.
statistics: 5000 paired base-graph bootstrap resamples; average all relevant settings and fixed seeds within graph before resampling. No query-node pseudoreplication. Fresh test bank is independent of previous development banks but belongs to the same known generator family.
gates: Primary teacher-effect gate: upper95CI(Mask distill - Mask CE exact-Grid6 KL)<0. Report accuracy separately; do not infer accuracy improvement from KL. Competitive compression gate additionally requires Mask distill matched KL<=0.01 and same-device median visible-input inference at least2x faster than Grid6-BP. Factor results are secondary and cannot rescue a failed Mask primary. Report teacher preparation and new student training costs separately.
validity: Before training: immutable prior-source lock, no train/test seed overlap, disjoint masks/budgets, teacher normalization/context clamps, teacher hidden-value poison invariance, class flip equivariance, native BP-only parity, soft-label KL/CE gradient equivalence and query-only loss masking; exact initial trainable/frozen digests match paired historical CE arm. Source and banks locked before any training/evaluation. No model/loss/primary changes after result inspection.
limits: Known-family distillation/compression experiment, not a new method or novelty claim. Earlier feature-free JR teacher experiments are distinct but already establish that distillation itself is not new. No real graph, unseen semantic schema, non-Gaussian feature law, 99.5% missing or large-graph scaling tested. No deployment teacher call or target-graph gradient update. Existing CE checkpoints and train tasks are reused, so only evaluation seeds are fresh. Parameter counts differ across architectures; within-architecture CE/distill counts are identical. Full enumeration is exponential and is not a scalable teacher claim.
